verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents built-in TOTP code generation for saved logins, and a community user reports relying on it for all 2FA, so the core of generating codes is delivered. Nothing in the evidence shows enrolling a new account by scanning a QR code, and one community comment suggests integrated TOTP is tied to paid plans. Missing for 10: documented QR-code scanning/enrollment flow, evidence of immediate code generation after scan, hands-on corroboration of the setup experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA.
If you are paying for Pass Plus or Proton Unlimited then you have integrated 2FA/TOTP
